provenance_note: The commit identifies the repository evidence copied for this snapshot, not a claim that every historical run used that commit. Original per-run source, protocol, model and assembly hashes are retained where recorded.
comparison_rules: Keep component flight, full mission, blind mapping, perception and software-test denominators separate.
Do not compare generic PX4 aircraft metrics directly to the Scout 110-B as a hardware fidelity measurement.
Known-map mission runs use ideal external positioning; blind mapping starts with an empty map.
Repeated known cases and successive development attempts are not independent real-world reliability samples.
Unmeasured hardware values are null, never zero or an inferred pass.
Freeze component revisions, firmware/model identities, camera settings, scenario, scoring method and gates before paired physical/simulation comparison.
Commit sanitized summaries and evidence hashes; keep model weights, network credentials and bulk recordings out of Git.

limitations: Ideal external position/velocity/attitude reference; noisy gyro only. Adaptive feedback uses velocity/gyro derivatives. No implemented onboard ESP32 estimator/controller firmware.
Static propulsion interpolation and first-order motor lag; no CFD, ground effect, rotor interference or structural flexibility.
Linear OCV/SOC and resistive battery; camera timing is synthetic, not video recognition or real Wi-Fi.
Component geometry/mass distribution and controller gains are provisional; source data coverage is not hardware qualification.
Heading may be released during motor faults; flight gates do not qualify camera stability or recognition during spinning recovery.

protocol.launch_client: HTTP evaluator; no operator dashboard required
protocol.scene: unchanged native-hard-v1 with existing Poly Haven assets
protocol.navigation: Height-aware routes; 0.58 m 3D planning clearance, 0.35 m monitored envelope. Earlier attempts used 2D footprint distance.
protocol.backend_change: Rapier microquad / ideal external reference replaces PX4 generic quad. Not an isolated comparison of perception.

frozen_software.vision_policy: cross-model-category-v1; two-view neutral Qwen crop identity AND independent Florence identity; geometry-guided acquisition

memory.metric: sum of macOS process physical footprints
memory.guard_metric: Larger of summed RSS and summed physical footprints; RSS can double-count shared pages.
memory.scope: Evaluator and its child processes (optional visual reviewer or Laya, camera browser including GPU/helpers, Node, simulator/PX4/MAVSDK) plus the app/Qwen process tree. Excludes unrelated applications and user browser tabs. Sampling is not an OS-enforced RAM limit.

limitations: Eight known synthetic development cases repeated three times; not held-out real-world validation.
Known operator map and ideal external positioning.
Provisional propulsion, battery, mass and camera mounting parameters.
Benchmark camera 960x540; physical camera bench defaults to 640x480.
Measured on a 16 GiB Apple Silicon host; actual 8 GB hardware untested.
One active aircraft; physical flight and concurrent fleet operation disabled.
Aircraft controller firmware, carrier layout and real indoor positioning remain hardware work.
Operator interventions wait for supervisor checkpoints; they are not an independent hardware emergency channel.

blind_exploration.scope: Historical synthetic flight results; not new runs or real-hardware qualification
blind_exploration.development_warning: Successive engineering attempts are not independent reliability samples; do not pool them into a success rate.
blind_exploration.raw_evidence_note: Images, video, IMU traces, planning arrays and full frozen source archives remain local and are excluded from this repository.

physical_checks.measurement: Gazebo joint velocities multiplied by the SDF rotor slowdown factor; actual simulated joints, not commanded motor speeds.
physical_checks.limitations: Generic rigid-body, motor and collision models. No physical airframe calibration or propeller flex/propwash validation.
